# Security policy

Report security vulnerabilities affecting J6 Code privately via
[GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/ykzird/j6code/security/advisories/new). Please do not
disclose them publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://github.com/ykzird/j6code/blob/main/SECURITY.md) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
